mapper.select:
SELECT count(1) AS cnt FROM t_service_contract AS sct LEFT OUTER JOIN t_business_customer_contractor AS bcc ON bcc.charges_occur_business_id = sct.charges_occur_business_id AND bcc.customer_id = sct.customer_id
INNER JOIN t_electricity_need_contract AS enc ON enc.contract_id = sct.contract_id AND enc.start_date <= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END AND enc.end_date >= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END LEFT OUTER JOIN t_contract_type_plan AS ctp ON ctp.contract_type_id = enc.contract_type_id AND ctp.start_date <= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END AND ctp.end_date >= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END
LEFT OUTER JOIN t_billing AS blg ON blg.bill_business_operator_id = sct.bill_business_operator_id AND blg.bill_id = sct.bill_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN t_measure_point AS msp ON msp.contract_id = sct.contract_id AND msp.start_date <= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END AND msp.end_date >= CASE sct.contract_end_date WHEN '99991231' THEN #referenceDate# ELSE sct.contract_end_date END ]]>
sct.contract_id LIKE #contractId#
convert_from(decrypt(bcc.contractor_phone_number1,#cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #contractorPhoneNumber#
msp.feed_point_number LIKE #feedPointNumber#
enc.old_number LIKE #oldNumber#
convert_from(decrypt(bcc.contractor_name,#cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #contractorName#
( convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address1, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address2, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address3, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address4, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address5, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address6, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address7, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# OR convert_from(decrypt(blg.billing_mail_address8, #cryptKey#::bytea, 'aes'), 'UTF8') LIKE #billingMailAddress# )
sct.contract_start_date >= #contractStartDateFrom#
sct.contract_start_date <= #contractStartDateTo#
sct.contract_end_date >= #contractEndDateFrom#
sct.contract_end_date <= #contractEndDateTo#
